title: Diffusion Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.33803v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reward models underpin the alignment of large language models, yet the dominant designs reduce each prompt--response pair to a point estimate or to a distribution from a fixed parametric family. This is at odds with human preference, which is inherently multimodal: the same response can be reasonably judged in many ways, and no single family covers all of them. To better fit this structure, we introduce DRM, a Diffusion Reward Model that recasts reward modeling as conditional density estimation over $p(\mathbf{r}\mid x,y)$. Conditioned on a frozen LLM encoder, a lightweight Diffusion Transformer denoises Gaussian noise into a reward vector, placing no parametric assumption on the output distribution and naturally representing its multimodal structure. translated_abstract: 奖励模型是大语言模型对齐的基础，然而主流设计将每个提示-响应对简化为一个点估计或来自固定参数族的分布。这与人类偏好的本质相悖，因为人类偏好天然具有多模态性：同一个响应可以被多种方式合理评判，没有任何单一参数族能够覆盖所有这些评判方式。为了更好地拟合这一结构，我们提出了DRM（扩散奖励模型），它将奖励建模重新表述为对 p(r|x,y) 的条件密度估计。以冻结的LLM编码器为条件，一个轻量级的扩散Transformer将高斯噪声去噪为奖励向量，不对输出分布施加任何参数化假设，从而自然地表示其多模态结构。单一架构可同时处理多属性回归和成对偏好数据，在推理时，N个采样结果可构成一个经验奖励分布并加以聚合（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出扩散奖励模型DRM，将奖励建模重构为条件密度估计任务，通过轻量级扩散Transformer将噪声去噪为奖励向量，无需参数化假设即可自然刻画人类偏好的多模态结构，并以单一架构统一处理多属性回归与成对偏好数据。
en_tdlr: Proposes DRM, a Diffusion Reward Model that recasts reward modeling as conditional density estimation, using a lightweight Diffusion Transformer to denoise Gaussian noise into reward vectors, naturally capturing the multimodal structure of human preferences without parametric assumptions while unifying multi-attribute regression and pairwise preference data in a single architecture.
